name: Voidsong
source:
Illayla stands upon the precipice of extinction. Paralysed by terror from the indomitable darkness within the mountains, ignorance and denial are all that keeps what little sanity that remains from folding inwards. Where hope and evolution dies in a chokehold of stagnation, a looming extinction becomes a crisis none have the courage to heed.

The dreaded virus, the Affliction, tightens its grasp, promising a slow, inexorable decline into starvation and ruin. The few brave enough to address it are silenced with glances that devour the heart. What little Blackrunners remain are scattered and removed, unable to help as the world they’re duty-bound to decipher sits by and rots away.

Salvation lies only with the inimical power of The Last Human. But the feared sorcerer’s promise of a cure died when he disappeared into obscurity. Now it falls to Mylo, the child of Smoke and Flame, to find the human and bring him home.

The reunion of pupil and teacher is fraught with peril, rage and raw power. In their search for hope and home, both must contend not only with one another, but a mysterious curse so far removed from sense and reason that it boils the soul and evaporates flesh.

Within a furnace of rage and love, the fate of a distant empire must be decided.

Nihilis awaits.

Voidsong is an action-horror sci-fi mystery and a generational sequel to Soulcreek. 

Following in the footsteps of Mylo, learn the greater secrets of the world after the devastating events of the Cascade as he battles with his personal trauma. 

[From [url=https://ryuovn.itch.io/voidsong]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
伊莱拉正立于灭绝的悬崖边缘。群山深处不可撼动的黑暗散发出令人窒息的恐怖，唯有无知与自欺，才勉强维系着残存的些许理智不至彻底崩塌。当希望与进化在停滞的桎梏中窒息而亡，迫在眉睫的灭顶之灾却成了一场无人敢于正视的危机。

可怕的病毒“灾疫”正越收越紧，预示着整个世界将缓慢而又不可逆转地滑向饥荒与毁灭。少数敢于直面它的人，都在噬人心魄的冷冽目光下被迫噤声。仅存的寥寥数名“黑行者”流散四方、遭到排挤，只能眼睁睁看着自己本应肩负解读职责的世界坐以待毙、日渐腐朽，却无能为力。

唯一的救赎，唯有寄托于“最后的人类”那可怖的力量。然而自那位令人畏惧的术士销声匿迹、隐入暗处后，他曾许下的解药承诺也随之破灭。如今，重任落在了烟与火之子迈洛肩上——他必须找到那名人类，将他带回家园。

师徒二人的重逢充满了凶险、狂怒与狂暴的力量。在追寻希望与归途的旅途中，两人不仅要彼此交锋，更要对抗一道超乎常理与认知的神秘诅咒——那诅咒足以煮沸灵魂、蒸发血肉。

在狂怒与爱意交织的熔炉之中，遥远帝国的命运即将揭晓。

尼希利斯正在等待。

《虚空之歌》是一部融合动作恐怖与科幻悬疑元素的视觉小说，也是《魂溪》的跨世代续作。

追随迈洛的脚步，在他与自身创伤抗争的过程中，揭开毁灭性的“大倾覆”事件之后这个世界更深层的秘密。

[摘自[url=https://ryuovn.itch.io/voidsong]itch.io[/url]]
